name: eyedroptracker

scripts.app:sync: node scripts/version.mjs && vite build && cap sync
scripts.app:android: npm run app:sync && cap open android
scripts.app:ios: npm run app:sync && cap open ios
scripts.reader:score: node scripts/reader-score.mjs tests/fixtures/independent-notes-1.json && node scripts/reader-score.mjs tests/fixtures/independent-notes-2.json && node scripts/reader-score.mjs tests/fixtures/independent-notes-3.json
scripts.oscar:lock: EDT_LOCK_TEST=1 node scripts/extension.mjs --dev --oscar=https://other-clinic.example.com && node oscar/lock.mjs && node scripts/extension.mjs --dev

description: Eye drop calendars, prescriptions and reminders for eye care teams and their patients.
